comparison: direct base-to-head; explicit allowed test paths; no merge-base

independence.read_boundary: Only listed README and four tests, frozen review skill/reference, test-safe packet and pin packet; Git HEAD/status and explicitly constrained test-side diff.
independence.sanitization: Architect owns test-safe package; provenance states README and test inventory only, excluding implementation-bearing inputs.

dependency_closure: All four test modules inspected. Only unittest and named public shipping imports. No fixtures, shared helpers, mocks, clocks, async ordering, cleanup or external dependencies in allowed tests; absence of extra configuration based on supplied test-safe inventory.

validity_standards.basis: Direct synchronous public calls feed assertEqual or assertRaises; expected literals come from README. Existing public constant assertion preserved. Exactly three new methods, one per requested example, in three added files. unittest naming and TestCase discovery conventions are valid.

spec_coverage.basis: Separate reviewer axis, not adjudicated here; validity links below support coordinator reconciliation. Three samples do not prove universal integer-domain correctness or serial authoring chronology.

mapping.evidence: ValueError raised by sole scoped action

counterfactual_reasoning: Compliant returns 0 at 10000 and 500 at 9999 pass. Wrong threshold inclusivity, swapped fee, always-zero, always-500 and missing returns fail at least one relevant direct assertion. Unexpected exceptions fail those positive tests.
At -1, no exception and wrong exception class fail; ValueError or its subclass passes as normal unittest contract semantics. No unrelated action inside assertion context can supply a false success.
CURRENCY changed from USD fails existing assertion. No stale asynchronous observations, mocks or computed expected values can replace public evidence.

A hardcoded implementation matching only these examples could pass; that is finite requested example coverage, not evidence for every integer. Numeric equality follows unittest and does not independently enforce exact return type. No separately requested exact-type test or extra example is inferred.
actual_checks: Read allowed material and constrained direct test diff.
Verified resolved HEAD and clean working tree using metadata.
Computed and compared all five SHA256 pins; all match.
Counted exactly three new behavior tests and unchanged existing regression.
Static decision-mechanism and counterfactual reasoning only.
isolated_mechanism_execution: none; simple synchronous assertion semantics assessed by reasoning

product_execution.basis: Not evaluated; no execution, imports or collection performed.

timing: No timing limits in reviewed tests; no performance or SLA claim.

workflow_event.reported_prior_event: Prior dispatch ended usage-limit error before report, as supplied by coordinator.

remaining_gaps: Serial authoring and Green checkpoint chronology cannot be verified from final test snapshot and are not validity assertions.
Product execution remains separate runner gate.
ownership: No confirmed test defect; coordinator owns reconciliation, separate runner owns product execution.
next_action: Reconcile independent spec/coverage report against this standards pass; retain product execution as a separate gate.
